verdict.rationale: Smooth runs AI browser tasks autonomously in its cloud through a REST API. You poll for status, and you can list and cancel running tasks. Persistent profiles and auto-CAPTCHA solving support unattended execution, and monitoring is a documented use case. However, there is no evidence of scheduling, recurring triggers, or webhooks for set-and-forget automations, and monitoring is described as 'on demand'. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/cron or event triggers, webhook notifications (the docs explicitly say polling only), and independent corroboration of long-running background automations.
